title: [Linux.conf.au 2013] - The real story behind Wayland and X
summary: A linux.conf.au 2013 talk by a Wayland developer who previously worked on X, telling the history of X and why Wayland was created. It covers X's hardware abstraction and architecture and why they became problematic for modern graphics.
why: Whenever Wayland versus X comes up, HN points to this talk as the authoritative explanation from an X maintainer of why X was replaced.

quote.text: a great presentation by one of the guys behind wayland, who worked on X a lot before
